```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# To render this CV locally:
# install.packages(c("vitae", "rmarkdown", "tinytex"))
# tinytex::install_tinytex() # only needed if you do not already have LaTeX installed
# From the repository root: rmarkdown::render("professional/full-cv.Rmd")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(vitae)

# Allow rendering from either the repository root or the professional/ folder.
cv_paths <- c("content/complete_cv.csv", "../content/complete_cv.csv")
cv_path <- cv_paths[file.exists(cv_paths)][1]
if (is.na(cv_path)) {
  stop("Cannot locate content/complete_cv.csv. Check the repository layout.")
}
cv <- read.csv(cv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required_columns <- c("section", "subsection", "what", "when", "with", "where", "why")
if (!all(required_columns %in% names(cv))) {
  stop("CV CSV is missing required columns: ",
       paste(setdiff(required_columns, names(cv)), collapse = ", "))
}
cv[is.na(cv)] <- ""
cv$section <- trimws(cv$section)  # CSV has a trailing space in 'Professional Organization '

# Normalize DATE DISPLAY ONLY; do not rewrite the source CSV.
# Known month names: Jan 2026, January 2026, Jan-26, and 11/2026 -> Jan 2026 etc.
# Ranges and labels ('Since', 'Certified:', 'Defense Target:') are retained.
# Seasons and academic years are intentionally preserved because they do not
# identify a precise month.
normalize_cv_date <- function(x) {
  month_abbr <- month.abb
  month_full <- month.name
  one <- function(s) {
    if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return("")
    # Numeric month / four-digit year, including within prose, e.g. Submitted 11/2026.
    pat_num <- "\\b(0?[1-9]|1[0-2])/(20[0-9]{2}|19[0-9]{2})\\b"
    matches <- gregexpr(pat_num, s, perl = TRUE)
    found <- regmatches(s, matches)[[1]]
    if (length(found) && found[1] != "") {
      replaced <- vapply(found, function(z) {
        parts <- strsplit(z, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        paste(month_abbr[as.integer(parts[1])], parts[2])
      }, character(1))
      regmatches(s, matches) <- list(replaced)
    }
    # Explicit abbreviated/full month followed by -YY, -YYYY, space YY, space YYYY.
    # Find and replace complete month-year tokens without affecting seasons.
    monthpat <- paste(c(month_full, month_abbr), collapse = "|")
    pat <- paste0("\\b(", monthpat, ")[[:space:]-]+([0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4})\\b")
    matches <- gregexpr(pat, s, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
    found <- regmatches(s, matches)[[1]]
    if (length(found) && found[1] != "") {
      replaced <- vapply(found, function(z) {
        parts <- strsplit(z, "[[:space:]-]+", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
        mi <- match(tolower(parts[1]), tolower(month_full))
        if (is.na(mi)) mi <- match(tolower(parts[1]), tolower(month_abbr))
        yy <- parts[length(parts)]
        if (nchar(yy) == 2) yy <- paste0("20", yy)
        paste(month_abbr[mi], yy)
      }, character(1))
      regmatches(s, matches) <- list(replaced)
    }
    s
  }
  vapply(as.character(x), one, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
cv$when <- normalize_cv_date(cv$when)
# Publication status in 'with' sometimes includes an actual month/year.
cv$with <- normalize_cv_date(cv$with)


entry_data <- function(section_name, subsection_name = NULL) {
  dat <- cv[cv$section == section_name, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(subsection_name)) {
    dat <- dat[dat$subsection == subsection_name, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  dat
}

print_detailed <- function(section_name, subsection_name = NULL) {
  dat <- entry_data(section_name, subsection_name)
  detailed_entries(dat, what = what, when = when, with = with, where = where, why = why)
}

print_brief <- function(section_name, subsection_name = NULL) {
  dat <- entry_data(section_name, subsection_name)
  brief_entries(dat, what = what, when = when, with = with)
}

latex_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""

  # Local LaTeX escaping avoids depending on xfun::escape_latex(),
  # which is not exported in some installed xfun versions.
  replacements <- c(
    "\\" = "\\textbackslash{}",
    "&"  = "\\&",
    "%"  = "\\%",
    "$"  = "\\$",
    "#"  = "\\#",
    "_"  = "\\_",
    "{"  = "\\{",
    "}"  = "\\}",
    "~"  = "\\textasciitilde{}",
    "^"  = "\\textasciicircum{}"
  )

  vapply(x, function(value) {
    if (!nzchar(value)) return("")
    chars <- strsplit(value, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    paste0(ifelse(chars %in% names(replacements), replacements[chars], chars), collapse = "")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

print_awards_grants <- function() {
  dat <- entry_data("Awards & Grants")
  dat <- dat[dat$what != "", , drop = FALSE]

  cat("\\begin{cvhonors}\n")
  invisible(apply(dat, 1, function(row) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\\cvaward{%s}{%s}{%s}{%s}\n",
      latex_escape(row[["when"]]),   # year
      latex_escape(row[["what"]]),   # award/grant name
      latex_escape(row[["with"]]),   # organization
      latex_escape(row[["where"]])   # award amount or note
    ))
  }))
  cat("\\end{cvhonors}\n")
}


# Compact layouts for list-style sections (no empty description bullets).
# These read the same CSV fields and keep the date formatting applied above.
print_organizations <- function() {
  dat <- entry_data("Professional Organization", "Membership")
  if (nrow(dat) == 0L) return(invisible(NULL))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {
    org <- dat$with[i]
    acronym <- dat$what[i]
    label <- if (nzchar(acronym)) paste0(org, " (", acronym, ")") else org
    cat(sprintf(
      "\\noindent\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.76\\textwidth}\\raggedright\\descriptionstyle{%s}\\end{minipage}\\hfill\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.22\\textwidth}\\raggedleft\\entrydatestyle{%s}\\end{minipage}\\par\\vspace{1.5mm}\n",
      latex_escape(label), latex_escape(dat$when[i])
    ))
  }
}

print_skills <- function() {
  dat <- entry_data("Skills & Certifications", "Skill")
  if (nrow(dat) == 0L) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat("\\begin{cvskills}\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\\cvskill{%s}{%s}\n",
      latex_escape(dat$where[i]), latex_escape(dat$what[i])
    ))
  }
  cat("\\end{cvskills}\n")
}

print_certifications <- function() {
  dat <- entry_data("Skills & Certifications", "Certification")
  if (nrow(dat) == 0L) return(invisible(NULL))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(dat))) {
    # Credential on first line; issuer and supplemental notes on second line.
    metadata <- c(dat$with[i], dat$where[i])
    metadata <- metadata[nzchar(trimws(metadata))]
    # Escape each element before inserting the intentional LaTeX separator.
    details <- paste(latex_escape(metadata), collapse = " \\textperiodcentered{} ")
    cat(sprintf(
      "\\noindent\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.76\\textwidth}\\raggedright\\entrytitlestyle{%s}\\par\\vspace{0.5mm}\\descriptionstyle{%s}\\end{minipage}\\hfill\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.22\\textwidth}\\raggedleft\\entrydatestyle{%s}\\end{minipage}\\par\\vspace{2mm}\n",
      latex_escape(dat$what[i]), details, latex_escape(dat$when[i])
    ))
  }
}
```
